criteria.given: The two requested demonstration-note paths are inspected
then: Both Markdown files exist
They contain the eight ordered section identifiers ORIENT, MODEL, ROUTE, WALKTHROUGH, EVIDENCE, RECOVERY, ADOPT, and CLOSE
They contain matching session outcomes
criteria.reason: Static documentation parity is established by direct inspection of both guides and their keyed section records.

criteria.given: A technical presenter has the rebuilt guide
criteria.when: They scan the document from beginning to end
then: The guide presents an opening, core model, lifecycle walkthrough, evidence and recovery, adoption exercise, and close
criteria.reason: The teaching arc is a static editorial contract; direct review is the observable evidence.

criteria.given: A presenter is preparing to run one guide section
then: They can find a concise cue card
They can find presenter guidance
They can find internal timing
The eight section timings sum to 90 minutes
They can find an observable audience outcome
criteria.reason: Cue cards, presenter guidance, timing, and outcomes are static document fields reviewed directly.

criteria.given: The guide describes a demonstration, example, or result
criteria.when: The claim is checked against the repository
then: Every command, result, historical example, and optional activity has exactly one LIVE, SAVED, or OPTIONAL label
SAVED rows identify their repository path and relevant SHA when applicable
Unverified execution is not presented as fact
criteria.reason: Evidence labels and execution claims are static prose and inventory records; no runtime behavior is introduced.

criteria.given: The guide makes a workflow or evidence claim
then: The referenced repository path exists
A relevant heading or excerpt is identified
An explicit support decision is recorded
criteria.reason: Citation support is a bounded editorial review of source paths and passages.

criteria.given: The English and Persian guides are compared
criteria.when: Their structure and meaning are reviewed
then: They match on section IDs and order, outcomes, timing, lifecycle, evidence labels, ownership boundaries, and primary or optional status
Natural language differences do not change the intended meaning
criteria.reason: Cross-language semantic parity is established by direct comparison of keyed records and natural-language meaning.

criteria.given: The rebuilt guide is compared with the current 40-slide notes
criteria.when: A presenter evaluates scanability and scope
then: Each rebuilt note is at least 35% shorter by line count than its current-language baseline
A safety checklist confirms that the core model, ownership, evidence, recovery, and failure boundaries remain
The core AskIt model and safety boundaries remain present
criteria.reason: Line-count reduction and preservation of named safety boundaries are static, reproducible documentation checks.
